CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Mount Carmel Contest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Mount Carmel Contest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.
   C. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   C. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   D. Say Work has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   B. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.

12. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain A hand writes on the wall and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mount Carmel Contest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Birth of Moses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The call of Moses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
